name: Blasted Lands
summary: In the Blasted Lands, Nethergarde Keep watches a wasteland scarred by the Dark Portal. Red clay and barren rock cover the former Black Morass, while demons and Dreadmaul ogres still threaten the region.

sections.title: A Scarred Wasteland
sections.body:
Once, the Blasted Lands belonged to the Black Morass, a stretch of dense fenland. During the First War, the warlock Gul'dan and the possessed Medivh tore open the Dark Portal and unleashed the orcish Horde. Fel energies poured through the breach. They drained the land of moisture and baked it into cracked red clay.

The Portal was destroyed at the end of the Second War. Its shockwaves scorched the ground again and turned the native stone crimson.

sections.title: Nethergarde's Lonely Vigil
sections.body:
Nethergarde Keep watches the only road into the valley from the northern bluffs. Archmage Khadgar and the Kirin Tor commissioned the stone fortress after the Second War. Its mages and soldiers are sworn to stop renewed demonic or orcish incursions.

The posting is strict. Garrison members who break its rules are banished to the Stockade in Stormwind. Dreadmaul ogres remained after Draenor's fall and keep the defenders under pressure. They raid the roads and attack the gates under fell guidance.

sections.title: The Legion's Remnant
sections.body: The Tainted Scar cuts through the southwestern Blasted Lands, a cratered canyon filled with demons. After the Legion's defeat at Mount Hyjal, doomguard commander Lord Kazzak gathered wandering demons, doomguard, and felhounds under his banner. His dreadlord lieutenant, Razelikh the Defiler, directs the Shadowsworn cultists at the Altar of Storms and commands the local Dreadmaul ogres.

sections.title: The Power of the Blood
sections.body:
Scholars and wanderers still brave the Blasted Lands in search of discoveries. Just inside the northern pass, Bloodmage Drazial and Bloodmage Lynnore experiment with organs from scorpids, basilisks, and boars. They use them to brew potent physical enhancers.

Farther into the wastes, the draenei hermit Kum'isha seeks scattered draenethyst fragments, remnants of Draenor's shattered past. Travelers who recover them receive a reward from him.

faq.q: Why is the ground red and barren?
faq.answer: The Blasted Lands were once part of the marshy Black Morass. The Dark Portal's raw demonic magic drained the region of life and moisture. When the Portal was destroyed, its searing heat and chaotic energies turned the clay into hard crimson earth.

The Dark Portal is a massive gateway between Azeroth and Draenor, the sundered orcish homeworld now known as Outland. Though destroyed to sever the bridge between worlds, its great stone frame still stands under Nethergarde Keep's watch.

Nethergarde Keep is an Alliance bastion overseen by Kirin Tor mages and soldiers loyal to Stormwind. Built after the Second War under Archmage Khadgar's direction, it keeps a strict watch over the Dark Portal and repels nearby ogre and demon attacks.

The Tainted Scar is a demon-filled canyon in the southern Blasted Lands. It shelters the remaining Burning Legion forces in the Eastern Kingdoms, led by the powerful doomguard Lord Kazzak and including doomguards, felguards, and felhounds.

faq.q: Who are the blood elves camping near the entrance?
faq.answer: Bloodmage Drazial and Bloodmage Lynnore are researchers studying how the corrupted fauna adapted to the harsh fel landscape. They trade potent elixirs that bolster mortal attributes for entrails, brains, and lungs from native basilisks, vultures, scorpids, and boars.

Kum'isha is a draenei mystic who lives in the central wastes. He collects draenethyst fragments and spheres from Draenor, and trades sealed packs of rare equipment and goods to those who bring them to him.

faq.q: How do you reach the Blasted Lands on foot?
faq.answer: Travel through Deadwind Pass east into the Swamp of Sorrows. Follow the main road south past the Horde settlement of Stonard, then take the narrow mountain pass into the Blasted Lands.

faq.q: Why are there ogres living in the desert?
faq.answer: The Dreadmaul ogres crossed the Dark Portal during the Second War. They stayed instead of retreating through the rift, entrenched themselves in Dreadmaul Hold, and fell under the thrall of the dreadlord Razelikh and the Shadowsworn cult.

angles.text: As a mage, you can see Nethergarde Keep's stern use of the arcane in its vigil against fel corruption and the dimensional rifts left by Medivh's fall.
As a warlock, you can find powerful demons in the Tainted Scar, while Daio the Decrepit dwells among the rocks. The land offers seasoned warlocks rare chances to bind dangerous fel entities.
As a herbalist, you can find Gromsblood growing in the Blasted Lands' arid red clay, one of the few natural places where it grows.
As an Alliance member, you can find your only fortified haven in the region at Nethergarde Keep. It guards the kingdom's southern reaches from threats to Duskwood and Stormwind.
As a Horde member, you can find no Horde fortress here. The Dark Portal's ruins remain a grim monument to the Old Horde's crossing and the devastation of demonic corruption.
